interface.name: post_apollo_company_vector_v1

description.summary: private Company native map launch intent and geometry candidates

interface.description:
This interface is advertised ONLY to the compositor-selected native Company layer-shell Wayland client. Each bind and request revalidates the exact wl_client and native role/surface selection. The compositor never publishes the interface on normal startup.
Every status and geometry is observational/candidate-only. This protocol does NOT launch, resize, crop, render, focus, authorize keyboard/pointer, allow popups, or prove ownership of a native Qt MapLibre actor.

entry.name: denied
entry.summary: no trusted native selection or stale client

arg.name: mode
arg.summary: fixed token, not URL or process PID

arg.name: frame_x
arg.summary: Company frame x relative to paired native layer

arg.name: frame_y
arg.summary: Company frame y relative to paired native layer

arg.name: map_x
arg.summary: map canvas x relative to Company frame

arg.name: map_y
arg.summary: map canvas y relative to Company frame

arg.name: revision_hi
arg.summary: current compositor host geometry revision high bits

arg.name: revision_lo
arg.summary: current compositor host geometry revision low bits
